from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
import itertools

n = 22
edges = list(itertools.combinations(range(n), 2))
edge_to_var = {e: i + 1 for i, e in enumerate(edges)}

solver = Glucose3()

# No red K_5 (color 0). So for any 5 vertices, at least one edge is blue (True).
for clique in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
    clause = [edge_to_var[e] for e in itertools.combinations(clique, 2)]
    solver.add_clause(clause)

# No blue K_4 (color 1). So for any 4 vertices, at least one edge is red (False).
for clique in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    clause = [-edge_to_var[e] for e in itertools.combinations(clique, 2)]
    solver.add_clause(clause)

print("Solving...")
if solver.solve():
    print("SAT")
    model = solver.get_model()
    colors = [1 if model[edge_to_var[e] - 1] > 0 else 0 for e in edges]
    print(colors)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
